text:
Keep in mind, thick plastic hangers may not fit.... THE GOOD:
--------------
* Can use horizontally or vertically for saving space.
* You 12 of them in this pack.
* Made of metal, with 30 lbs. load capacity for each hanger.

THE BAD:
------------
* At some point in your life, you must have thought all those bent wire hangers look ugly, and you replaced them all with solid plastic ones. Well if you did, you need to go back to bent wires to use this accessory. LOL! Thick plastic hangers won't fit. You can force them in, but then you need to force it out, which then makes it an inconvenience to use. I think they need to go back to the drawing board. Make the opening a little bigger so all hangers can fit. This is such an oversight and a potential loss of so many buyers.

I'll go 3-Stars.
